note: Body has two lines: the first trims to exactly '))' (forcing the stripped-form fallback), the second ('x ') has trailing whitespace. The stripped form strips trailing whitespace from every content line on emission, so the fallback would silently lose it. See Sec 5.9.7. The String is wrapped in an Object (key 's') so it is not the bare document root: a bare String would fail ScalarRoot first, and the fixture must exercise exactly its named reason code (Sec 5.9.0).
